title: Heart
subtitle: Two lobes and a point
description: Two round lobes with a notch between them, and a point below.

It is the shape that made a row able to hold more than one span: its top rows are two separate pieces of material, and its lower rows are one. A single interval per row could not say that, so a heart would have been a shield with a filled-in dip.
